# Site Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SiteType`](gmeow-SiteType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SiteType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The purpose of an organization's site — headquarters, branch, registered office, etc. A value, not a subclass.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SiteType`](gmeow-SiteType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the site-purpose axis — the open set (headquarters, branch, registered, …) referenced through [`gmeow:siteType`](../properties/gmeow-siteType.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing [`gmeow:Location`](gmeow-Location.md) by site purpose (purposes are values, not classes) and avoid reusing an ill-fitting seed; mint a fresh [`gmeow:SiteType`](gmeow-SiteType.md) individual when the purpose is missing.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:SiteType`](gmeow-SiteType.md) individual from a site via [`gmeow:siteType`](../properties/gmeow-siteType.md), or mint a new individual carrying [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) and [skos:definition](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition) when the open set lacks the purpose.

### Examples

- ex:siteTypeWarehouse a [`gmeow:SiteType`](gmeow-SiteType.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "warehouse"@en.
